Merge pull request #9 from anthropics/tianyi-ant-patch-1

Update README.md

chore: bump mathlib to 300d0e5, fix breaking changes (#1201)

Bumps mathlib from c0da404 to 300d0e5, 159 commits on.

- mathlib#41702 made `v` and `w` explicit in
`NumberField.LiesOver.completionMap`, `continuous_completionMap` and
`completionMap_coe`; updated the three call sites in
`FLT/NumberField/Completion/Infinite.lean`. Every other error in that
file came from this one.
- `Mathlib.Data.Int.SuccPred` is deprecated;
`FLT/AutomorphicForm/Stuff.lean` now imports
`Mathlib.Order.SuccPred.Int`.
- Mathlib now warns when a non-module file imports it, which fails `lake
test --iofail`; `FLTTest/MathlibCompatibility.lean` is now a module.

refactor: extract optimization constants for tagging (#7431)

Another follow on to #4950

This PR refactors some files so that the constant from the Optimization
Constants tracking page has its own definition, so we can tag it and
better link the two definitions.

I used Claude Code to assist in identifying candidates for which this
could be done easily.
